findings.headline: Replace the babel-preset-solid preset with the @solidjs/babel-plugin plugin.
findings.why: babel-preset-solid compiles JSX for Solid 1. Its Solid 2 successor, @solidjs/babel-plugin 2.0.2, is a Babel plugin, not a preset, so it goes in plugins, and it emits code for @solidjs/web.
findings.guidance: Remove this preset, add "@solidjs/babel-plugin" to plugins, and swap the package in package.json. Options such as generate, hydratable, delegateEvents and wrapConditionals carry over; moduleName now defaults to "@solidjs/web"; builtIns, staticMarker and omitServerOnlyTemplates changed or are gone. Migrate makes the move when the options all carry over and no preset other than TypeScript's is listed after this one (those ran before it, and a plugin runs before every preset); it leaves the rest to you. Projects built with @solidjs/vite-plugin don't need a Babel preset for JSX at all.

findings.headline: Point this jsxImportSource option at @solidjs/web.
findings.why: Solid 2 no longer ships JSX runtime entries from solid-js; web projects take them from @solidjs/web, so a build tool that resolves JSX through solid-js fails to resolve solid-js/jsx-runtime.
findings.guidance: Set it to "@solidjs/web", as in tsconfig.json; migrate makes this edit.

findings.headline: Update 'solid-js/web' in this module list to @solidjs/web.
findings.why: Solid 2.0.3 has no solid-js/web module, so this entry no longer matches anything. A bundler external or dependency-optimizer list that misses the Solid 2 package bundles a second copy of the runtime, which breaks reactivity and context across the copies.
findings.guidance: Replace the entry with @solidjs/web. A regular expression or a function that matches solid-js/ also needs @solidjs/ added.

findings.headline: Update 'solid-js/store' in this module list to solid-js (stores are part of it).
findings.why: Solid 2.0.3 has no solid-js/store module, so this entry no longer matches anything. A bundler external or dependency-optimizer list that misses the Solid 2 package bundles a second copy of the runtime, which breaks reactivity and context across the copies.
findings.guidance: Replace the entry with solid-js (stores are part of it), or remove it when solid-js is already listed. A regular expression or a function that matches solid-js/ also needs @solidjs/ added.
